The put marked 76.66 implied volatility and the call marked 46.82, so money in this pipe is paying for protection under 74,000 rather than for a move through 90,000. The prior print carried an 18.75 point gap between a 75,000 put and a 92,000 call on the same expiry, which means the premium for downside insurance has widened.
